newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq falls on profit-taking after three-day rise.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq falls on profit-taking after three-day rise.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite Index dropped Friday as investors cashed in profits after a three-day rally.

The Nasdaq Composite Index shed 7.30 or 0.56 percent to 1288.56. The Dow retreated from its earlier sharp gains and unofficially closed up only 11 to 6484. The long bond dropped 8/32 to yield 6.61 percent.
"The market had a good run for a few days. It's Friday, it was time to do some profit taking," said Nelson Gold, a trader with Interstate-Johnson Lane Corp.
Another trader said the recent swings were not a solid sign of market strength since many investors and traders have taken early holidays.
Technology stocks fell after a positive run earlier in the week. Intel Corp dropped 2-7/8 to 134-5/8, Microsoft Corp slipped 1-1/4 to 83-5/8 and Dell Computer Corp sank 3 to 55.
Shares of Dendrite International Inc and Arterial Vascular Engineering Inc crumbled on weak earnings forecasts and analysts' rating cuts.
Losing stocks beat gaining stocks 2309 to 1987 on total volume of 641 million.
